makeup: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned; no online trophies
sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PSN list as published by Exophase and cross-checked on PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). Counts are PSN's progress targets via PSNProfiles. Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description; where a guide says something the description alone cannot prove, it says so. No guide text is copied from any other guide.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you earn. Work through the other 54 in any order — the roadmap in this guide puts the story first, then side strands, activities, robberies and collectibles, ending with 100% completion. There is no shortcut: the platinum only pops once every other trophy is yours.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Roadmap: our own plan built from the official descriptions.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and finish it. It is the first story mission, so it comes naturally at the start of the game — follow the on-screen objectives until the mission ends. Flagged as one to watch only because it is tied to a single opening moment; keep a manual save before it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Keep playing the story missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Do the Chapter 1 meditation spot while you are here — it feeds the one confirmed missable on this list (Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Meditation tip: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide, reported by GGRecon.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 in full. Play the story missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. The asterisks in the name are how PlayStation publishes it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the hardest trophy on the list. The in-game stats page tracks what counts: story missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries. Clear every other trophy first; this one is the sum of all of them. Early estimates put the full run at roughly 200 hours (PowerPyx) to 300+ hours (Push Square) — treat both as early guesses, not measured times, since the game only launched on 19 November 2026.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. What 100% covers: GTA Culture completion guide, via Heyday. Time estimates: PowerPyx (~200 h) and Push Square (300+ h).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the tally, which PSN tracks. Weave stunts into normal driving instead of grinding them: every jump off a ramp or long drift adds up. Check the in-game stats to see your running total.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (250). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the game's side pastimes — fishing, arcade games, bowling, drone racing, shooting ranges, meditation, racing, hunting and the rest of the Leonida pastimes. One try at each is enough; you do not need to win or finish them.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (9 activity types). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the ranges around Leonida and work through each challenge until it scores gold. Practise weapon handling first on the easier challenges, then chase gold on the rest — the counter only moves on gold medals.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (42). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Find each drone-race spot, learn its course, and win once per location. Racing lines and shortcuts matter more than raw speed.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (14). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts as long as it is a race you have not won before — street races, off-road and the rest. The counter tracks distinct races, so repeating one you already won adds nothing.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (20). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, then out-fish him: reel steadily, watch the line tension, and land the bigger catch.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk up to any arcade cabinet in Leonida and play one game through to its end. Any cabinet counts.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (8). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy a published guide flags as missable: PowerPyx notes a first meditation in Chapter 1 can be missed, so meditate at the first spot the moment the game lets you, and hit every spot as you find it. Spots are spread across the whole map, so tick them off as you explore rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (18). Missable warning: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide, reported by GGRecon.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until he points you at the animal, then track it and take it down. Bring a scoped weapon and approach quietly — a unique animal is a one-off target, so keep a manual save before the hunt.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets of them. Three finished sets is the target — use the map to sweep each region, and trade duplicates if the game lets you.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (3 sets). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo and share feature: open it at scenic spots, landmarks and odd corners of Leonida and post from there. 100 distinct locations is the target — spread it across your exploration instead of grinding one area.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (100). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's small objectives — driving, shooting, flying and world tasks that tick off as you play. Fifty is a lot, so keep an eye on the challenge list in the pause menu and clear the easy ones as you go.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (50). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the cops to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Use alleys, tunnels and a fast car — and keep a manual save first, since it needs your partner beside you.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level you already have — do not let it drop between shops and do not get caught. Plan a route with three close shops first.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or sit in 100 different vehicles — cars, bikes, boats, trucks and anything else with an engine. Variety is what counts: a new model ticks the counter, a repeat does not.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (100). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight with at least five enemies close together, then drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy shootout and line the targets up before you trigger it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to Vice City International Airport and leave by a route the airport never scheduled — steal a plane and take off, or drive out through a gap in the perimeter. Expect airport security to notice, and keep a manual save first.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke about the heat inside them; in practice, face a Rhino tank in the world and survive the encounter. Heavy weapons and distance are your friends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, and get out before any alarm or witness spots you. A stealthy approach and a quick exit matter more than speed.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (5). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (52 areas). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one illegal operation per gang, hit it, and get away. Nine gangs, nine operations — the map and your contacts point you at them.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (9 gangs). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side — the classic GTA exit. Expect the staff to object, and keep a manual save first.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at that alley and play a full game through. Any score counts — finishing is what matters.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own reading of the official description — the moment itself is not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make choices as the story offers them — PSN tracks a count up to 500, so this is a long tally of decisions across the game, not one choice. Play the story naturally and the count climbs; some choices may lock others out, so keep manual saves before the big decisions.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target (500). How-to: our own reading of the official description — not yet verified in-game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try — a retry that lands. If a mission or challenge goes wrong, try it once more straight away.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own reading of the official description — the exact trigger is not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in the world — a rare event or odd sight in Leonida. Keep your eyes open while exploring; these moments are one-offs, so a manual save before exploring new areas does no harm.
trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own reading of the official description — the event itself is not pinned down yet.

trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.sources: Official name, description & grade: PSN trophy list via Exophase, cross-checked on PSNProfiles. Count: PSNProfiles progress target ($100,000). How-to: our own advice from the official description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register ten different vehicles to it. Any vehicles you own or find count — register them as you discover them.
